learning_objective: The learner can explain the difference between comparative and absolute evaluation and identify why comparative results alone cannot determine if a model is good enough for a specific use case.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that if model B beats model A in a ranking, model B is necessarily good enough for production.
Assuming a comparative win rate (e.g., 51%) can be directly converted into an absolute business metric like ticket resolution rate.
Overlooking that a comparative ranking can be valid even when both models being compared are actually bad.
